title: roku-debug
description: Debug configuration for roku-debug (Roku channel debugging with .bs source maps)

host.description: IP address of the Roku device

password.description: Developer password of the Roku device

outDir.description: Directory where the built zip is written

sourceMaps.description: Resolve breakpoints against the original .bs files via transpile source maps

enableDebugProtocol.description: Use the newer BrightScript debug protocol (Roku OS 9.1+)

injectRaleTrackerEvent.description: Inject RALE tracker events (Roku Advanced Layout Editor)

stopOnEntry.description: Break on the first line of the entry point

componentLibrariesPort.description: TCP port used by component library debugging

bsConst.description: Overrides for bs_const values in the manifest during this debug session

files.description: Glob patterns controlling which files ship in the debug build
